props.name: actionLabel
props.description: The action button's label and accessible name. Set it together with `onAction`, and write a label that makes sense without the alert text, such as "Retry sync".

props.name: children
props.description: The alert's text, an `Alert.Title` and an optional `Alert.Description`. Render both as direct children of `Alert.Root`, where the density catalog finds them.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Runs when the action button is clicked. The alert renders the button only when this and `actionLabel` are both set. `Alert.Root` is a server component, so pass the handler from a client component.

props.name: role
props.description: The live-region role. A screen reader announces an `alert` at once, interrupting the user, when it is inserted or its content changes. Keep `alert` for errors and warnings that need attention now. Pass `status` for an informational message, which the screen reader announces after it finishes speaking. It announces a status region only when its content changes while the region is in the DOM, so keep `Alert.Root` mounted and swap its children. Pass `none` for a static notice that is not announced.

props.name: variant
props.description: The status. It sets the alert's colours and its icon.

props.name: variant
props.description: The status whose glyph it draws. `default` and `info` draw Info, `warning` draws Warning, `destructive` draws WarningOctagon and `success` draws CheckCircle.

props.name: weight
props.description: The Phosphor stroke weight. `regular` draws a thinner stroke. Keep `fill` for selected or active states.

props.name: level
props.description: The heading level. `1` to `6` renders `h1` to `h6`. Set the level that fits the alert into the page's heading outline.
